scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rps/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @rps/server" "npm run dev -w @rps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rps/shared && npm run build -w @rps/server && npm run build -w @rps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @rps/shared && npm run test -w @rps/server && npm run test -w @rps/web
